name: Git, npm and publishing run on deterministic scripts
asks: That this whole, registry, pinning, publishing, that it all takes so much premium effort from agents, rather than happening automatically, deterministically, with scripts, is exactly what I am asking you to deal with. ... Invest in durable tooling that fixes this.

x-provenance.recorded-by: office agent of the 561 Group (Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior), development pass sigrid-publishing-1 of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus
x-provenance.basis: The Leader's utterances cited in `sources`, read in full. `asks` and `sources[].words` are the Leader's own words; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: That this whole, registry, pinning, publishing, that it all takes so much premium effort from agents, rather than happening automatically, deterministically, with scripts, is exactly what I am asking you to deal with. ... Invest in durable tooling that fixes this.

requirements.says: The host-work toolchain shall perform npm publishing, pinning and repinning, git committing and git pushing by deterministic scripts that need no inference per run.
requirements.rationale: [0mchGN7_pVcY]: 'a unified platform provided by this ecosystem'; about half the tokens went to git, npm, search and other deterministic work.

requirements.says: The host-work toolchain shall publish packages without a human in the loop.
requirements.rationale: [V9ilzfe0J4Lc],[IpJ7eFZaUTLw]: 'You published fine, no human in the loop, yesterday.'

requirements.says: The host-work toolchain shall report the first failing step and its cause when a publish fails.
The host-work toolchain shall be realized as tools, offices, duties, skills and scripts tied into the Group's systems.
requirements.rationale: [0mchGN7_pVcY]: 'real tools, real offices, duties, skills, scripts, tied into our real systems'.

requirements.says: The host-work toolchain shall resolve a failing gate or stale pin without escalating to the Founder.
requirements.rationale: [kO_vO9cOAyLI]: 'you have to act like 9999xx more autonomously ... why can't you publish shit?'

requirements.says: The agent harness shall record the share of a week's inference spent on git, npm, search and other host work.
requirements.rationale: [0mchGN7_pVcY],[kFh5AWB5xAAs]: about $300 a week on npm and git handling; npm publishing and git committing the single greatest cost in every session.

requirements.says: The repair of a host-work failure shall be made in the toolchain that owns the failing step, so the failure does not recur in later sessions.
requirements.rationale: [02vQDYwZcQco],[SHODv3i1bHyw]: 'this is like the 10th session today where you've gone can't publish'; the fix is not done if an agent running the wrong script somewhere brings it back.

requirements.says: The agent harness's dependency policy shall allow Node built-ins through the file-engineering section and carry no zero-dependency limitation.

conditions.says: Two consecutive publishes of a changed package run from a script with no human step and report success or the failing step.
A failure injected in the publish script is repaired in the owning script and does not recur in the next session's run.
A week's inference record shows the share spent on host work.
The harness configuration contains no zero-dependency line.
The tools, offices, duties and skills of the toolchain are listed in the agency.

board-opening.context: Other agent working the npm side at the time of [8rYEiuViKU-w] ('Another agent is working our npm shit right now'). Existing carriers to extend, never replace: the npm and git skills under the agency, the `.codex.bk` directory the Founder saw on 2026-09-12 as proof the harness cleanup was not done ([SHODv3i1bHyw]), and the registry and pin tooling of the computer-engineering section. The Founder's instruction that accepted flakiness and fragility of tooling be removed, especially tooling by which an agent receives work, policies and information and searches for context ([8rYEiuViKU-w]), is carried by R1 and R7.

sources.words: We literally are spending $300+ a week on you handling NPM stuff, git stuff. Invest in durable tooling that fixes this.
In EVERY session, NPM publishing and Git commiting have become the SINGLE GREATEST costs.
fine remove any 'dependencies' limitation ... remove the fucking line about zero-dep
You used to publish just fine, and today, you won't.
I see .codex.bk not .codex, so you clearly aren't actually fucking done.
